body ghost_id and conversation_id equal authenticated Ghost pair
body goal_id resolves to a Goal derived from a committed Owner turn via lifetime_turn_goals
Goal accountable_ghost and reply_conversation equal that pair

authoritative_source.prompt: Return the original immutable Host report prompt; do not rewrite historical reports or copy artifact contents
authoritative_source.failure: Missing, forged, ambiguous, foreign or stale report sources fail closed without a message or Owner lifecycle mutation

conversation.report.inspect.principal: authenticated exact Ghost, not JSON actor claim or owner impersonation
conversation.report.inspect.effect: read only; no seen bit, SDK/model resume, projection, receipt reset or artifact verification

conversation.report.reply.effect: Append one genuine model advisory in lifetime_turns; sender_kind=ghost, sender_ref=authenticated Ghost, kind=assistant_advisory, source_turn_id=NULL. Correlate immutably through lifetime_report_replies, not a fabricated Owner turn
conversation.report.reply.dedup: Same report and identical text returns the original reply ID and sequence even under another valid callback command. Changed text conflicts. Shared Envelope same-ID/body dedup remains authoritative

host_table.name: lifetime_report_replies

columns.outbox_id: INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES lifetime_outbox(id)
columns.reply_turn_id: TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES lifetime_turns(id)

host_table.migration: migration-013.sql; additive, preserves all IDs, ACKs, original receipts, turns, artifacts and acceptance

pi_callback.identity: report_id comes only from the incoming receiver envelope or committed SDK request ID; never from model arguments

pi_queue.reuse: existing per-conversation canonical queue, transition gate, submit barrier, SDK request lookup and durable reply projection; do not add a PC/global scheduler
pi_queue.source_kind: Add origin_kind=owner|work_report to ghost_canonical_turns, default owner for existing Owner records; report turn_id=request_id=the original receiver command ID
pi_queue.admission: Authenticate report source through conversation.report.inspect before canonical report admission. Queue during an active Owner turn; never use legacy direct SDK admission or mutate the Owner run
pi_queue.scope: A work_report has no active Owner turn capability. Only existing read-only controller tools may run; reject all Goal/Work/handoff/wait/mailbox/memory mutations before transport. Do not infer an artifact format from a locator suffix or describe producer completion as independent acceptance
pi_queue.completion: Use actual committed SDK AssistantEntry text and stable entry-bound callback invocation; project via conversation.report.reply. Report local lifecycle only, never conversation.turn_status for a notification
pi_queue.recovery: Observe existing submission by original request ID before any submit. Import a previously admitted legacy report into the canonical report projection without re-running its model, including a cached successful receiver receipt. Terminal failed/effect-unknown model work is not replayed. Inspect/status remain observation-only; explicit runtime.reconcile may recover committed report projection
pi_queue.privacy: Reuse current strongest disclosure, broker/local route guards, authority fencing and original ModelRef. No auth copy, global config changes, provider/model/account fallback or private-to-cloud lowering
